title: Bound original-address extraction of the stage-17 body shell
body:
This extends #7416’s affine-chart exclusion on the exact #7113 Type B body idles at clocks 4646 and 4660. In the original address basis the stage-17 residual D−E has the same nonzero Hamming-neighbor entry in every column, equal to −i/16 at width one. Thus even a non-affine coordinate selector must retain both full dirty lane volumes. The 13 unchanged intervening events are role scalars and supply no address-basis bridge in this window. The directed gross upper for two volumes is below −126.39 raw. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage17-original-address-extraction-bound/replay.py`. Two exact engines check the source, Gaussian entry and window, with registered and official read-only Git-free replay, exact commit checks and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. Mixed address extractors, outside bridges and altered erasure remain open.

#7334/#7113 supply the complete comparator and literal caller, #7416 the erased shell, #7406 the rank-two projector, and #7397 the retained volume tariff. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation and independent replay.
